title: com.matrixmedia.content_gate
description: State event defining the minimum subscription tier required to view content in a Matrix room. State key is the empty string (one gate per room). When the gate is removed, the bot sets content to {} to clear the state (ungated).

oneOf.description: Active content gate. Viewers must hold at least the specified tier level to access gated content.

min_tier_level.description: Minimum subscription tier level required to access content (1-5).

min_tier_name.description: Human-readable name of the minimum required tier (e.g. 'Silver').

creator_user_id.description: Fully-qualified Matrix user ID of the creator who set this gate (e.g. '@alice:example.org').

preview_seconds.description: Number of seconds of free preview before the gate enforces. 0 means no preview. Default is 120 seconds.

version.description: Schema version. Must be 1 for this version of the event schema.

oneOf.description: Cleared state. An empty object signals that content is ungated (no subscription required).
